attempts.summary: Built the required node2/node3-via-node1 private-network topology (node1 eth1↔node2 10.10.12.0/24, node1 eth2↔node3 10.10.13.0/24) and applied a VyOS QoS rate-control policy (1mbit TBF) as an egress shaper on node1's eth2 interface, capping only node2→node3 traffic at 1 Mbit/s while leaving node3→node2 traffic unrestricted. Verified with real cross-node transfers (~0.96 Mbit/s node2→node3 vs ~4.6 Gbit/s node3→node2). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (VyOS reconfiguration saved to config.boot, RHEL7 ifcfg/route files persisted), each proven via changed boot_id and confirmed to recover full connectivity and the shaping config after restart.
